summary: Diff implements a new centralized frontend money model/normalization layer and updates multiple pages/components to use cents-based arithmetic with a single conversion at render time. However, the requested admin-only backend query endpoint for raw stored monetary amounts is not evidenced in the backend diff summary, and it’s unclear whether all money input flows were audited/updated. The diff also includes several unrelated UI/UX and feature changes not requested by the BuildRequest.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a non-destructive, admin-only backend query endpoint to expose raw stored monetary amounts (IDs + raw Int amount + record type discriminator) for a specified groupId; non-admin callers must be rejected; no state changes.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo diff excerpt does not show any new admin-only query endpoint or related types/logic for returning sampled raw amounts across contributions, expenses, revenues, payouts, and planned payments. Frontend types mention RawAmountSample but no corresponding backend method is evidenced.
evidence: frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts (imports RawAmountSample type but no shown hook/method calling a raw-amount endpoint)

missing_requirements.requirement: Audit and update all money input flows so values submitted match the chosen money model consistently (2-decimal UX preserved, clear validation errors, newly created records render with same scale).
missing_requirements.reason: A parsing/validation path is introduced (moneyModel.ts delegates via money.ts), but the diff summary does not provide evidence that all money-submitting dialogs/forms were updated to use it, nor that validation/error handling was consistently applied across those flows.
evidence: frontend/src/lib/moneyModel.ts (truncated; shows intent to parse user input but implementation is truncated)
frontend/src/lib/money.ts (delegates parsing/validation, but no direct evidence of form/dialog adoption)
frontend-file-summaries.txt (mentions several dialogs but truncation prevents verifying they now submit normalized backend-expected units)
